title: The leveled approach: Using and evaluating text mining tools AVResearcherXL and Texcavator for historical research on public perceptions of drugs
reasoning: The paper discusses a methodological approach ('the leveled approach') for historical research and evaluates the usability of text-mining tools. While it mentions a 'hermeneutic approach' (a term associated with epistemology) and explores public perceptions of drugs (a topic with moral dimensions), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, ethics, or hermeneutics as its subject of study.
